name: u37-resource-shared-control
about: Placement sensitivity with exactly 1,000 total initial notes and 1,000 total new notes/day, 1,000 total reads/day across 1 store(s). Two independent stores are expressible in the generic engine, but stores are scheduled serially and queueing is modeled, so this is NOT a native contention benchmark or proof of independent current writers. Rate and body sizes are assumed stress inputs held equal between u37 and u38. Source: current src/storage/s2h_resources.json @own-work/ declares one file per fresh atomic group; @own-work-directory/ and @own-work-point/ add separately addressed metadata. Their registration, authentication, fencing, directory writes and explicit migration are NOT measured here. Legacy records are not automatically sharded. Cold reopen repeats per physical store, deliberately exposing its row cost.
